privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.1: Watching and swiping works without an account. Nothing is tracked and there are no ads.
privacy.2: If you log in with Google, we keep only Google's account number and the nickname you choose. Not your name, email address or profile photo.
privacy.3: Photos are made smaller in your browser before they are sent; that also removes location and camera data. We keep your photos, swipes and reports.
privacy.4: Delete your account here and everything is gone. Questions? Open an issue on GitHub.
